'''Morions''', a very dark variety of [[smoky quartz]], are unremarkable low-value [[gem]]s that can be found in small [[cluster]]s in any [[stone]]. They look a bit like [[bituminous coal]], but quickly loo{{k|k}}ing will reveal them to be gems.
